Copies of Purchase Order(s) along with corresponding Invoice(s) and Dispatch details s hall be submitted along with the offer as documentary evidence. ii) Party shall furnish the Test Certificates for Chemical Composition & Physical Properties ( Tensile Strength, Yield Strength, Elongation, Hardness & Solution Annealing) as per relevant s tandard, under review of Third-Party Inspection Agency M/s LRQA/TÜV/BVIS/PDIL/EIL.. iii) The certificates at Sr. No. II shall be as per EN 10204 Type 3.1 certification. iv) Certificate for Huey Test in conformance with ASTM A262 Practice C shall be furnished al ong with the supply. Acceptable limit shall be as per applicable Saipem/Casale specifications. v) Ferrite Content shall be less than 0.6% and the material shall be free from Sigma Phase. Party shall furnish certificate to this effect. vi) Party shall certify that the material supplied is suitable for Urea-Carbamate Service at 2 30 kg/cm² & 200°C. vii) PMI and dimensional inspection reports shall be furnished along with the supply. Dimen sions shall conform to NFL Drg. No. NG18767. viii) Sealing surfaces shall be properly machined and free from cracks, laps, pits, dents, scra tches, corrosion, deformation and other defects affecting sealing performance. ix) All test cert ificates shall be heat/lot traceable to the supplied gasket. . 5.
